This plot is small, only a small piece of my land, and I am growing beans together with other crops. Beans do not need fertilizer like maize does — my mother always said the beans feed the soil themselves. I did not get a FISP coupon, and even if I had one I would put it on the maize plot, not here. I will save my seed from last season like we always do, and work the plot myself with my family.
